description: Phase 8 Stage B-1 — auth-denial reason bounded set (Owner E2 ratified). Auth denial is NOT a governed refusal; access-control class, neither governance nor infra. 403/401 body carries {reason, detail} — NEVER outcome=refused. No auth code enters the admission-refusal registry.

auth_missing.detail_template: Authentication required. Provide a valid Authorization: Bearer <token> header.

auth_expired.detail_template: Access token expired. Refresh via POST /api/auth/refresh.

auth_scope_insufficient.detail_template: Caller identity is authenticated but the required scope grant is absent.

auth_identity_mismatch_for_wizard_sessio.detail_template: Caller identity does not match the wizard session's bound identity.
